status: Six point additions independently accepted; two other exact yod notes remain unresolved
scope: Independent visual challenge of the proposed yod interior dots using exact target, full-word and same-font positive/plain controls. This overlaps the source ledger; it is eight repeatedly inspected IDs, not eight new source positions or an independent whole-book comparison.
method: Inspect target shapes and contrasting source glyphs before applying any textual expectation. A continuous white band below a yod head and a separate compact low-left body can distinguish an added point despite a narrow lateral bridge to the continuing right stem. Plain long-tailed, irregular and damaged heads serve as counter-comparators. Two accepted dots are fully detached; four retain narrow bridges. Original embedded-image crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements only. No OCR reading, grammar, sharpening, synthetic pixels or renderer-created gray levels certify a mark.

decisions.finding: The compact lower-left lobe lies below a white band under the yod head and projects from its continuing right stem through a narrow bridge. It matches the position/shape of clear source dageshes; the same-page plain yods, including long tails and damaged heads, lack that added lobe.
